turns.text: Hi everyone. I think faster than I can draw, especially when I present an idea or a flow to stakeholders. [[slnc 1000]] Everyone has to wait while I catch up. And afterwards, the rough drawing is hard to revise or share. [[slnc 1000]] AI can help the drawing keep up with the explanation. We can visualize our thoughts as we explain the flow. [[slnc 1000]] So I built Sprig. [[slnc 1000]] It's a canvas-first app. You explain an idea aloud, and OpenAI's GPT Transcribe turns your speech into text. [[slnc 1000]] Sprig uses that to update the diagram while you talk. Share your screen in a meeting and everyone can follow the idea as it takes shape. [[slnc 1000]] It listens without talking back. That's Sprig. Thanks for watching.
